summary.detail: Degree-seeking undergraduate study at Chinese universities approved by the programme; applicant must be a high school graduate under 25. Chinese-taught programmes need HSK Level 3 (Chinese language programmes exempt); bachelor's applicants must take the CSCA. Majors available at each university are listed in the Study in China (CSC) system, not named on the embassy pages. Funding in the 2026/2027 call covers AY 2026/2027 only.
summary.source_text: be a high school graduate under the age of 25 when applying for undergraduate programs

summary.detail: Degree-seeking master's study; applicant must be a bachelor's holder under 35. Chinese-taught programmes need HSK Level 4; other-language programmes need IELTS/TOEFL per the university. Majors available at each university are listed on the CSC website, not named on the embassy pages.
summary.source_text: be a bachelor's degree holder under the age of 35 when applying for master's programs

summary.detail: Degree-seeking doctoral study; applicant must be a master's holder under 40. Chinese-taught programmes need HSK Level 4; other-language programmes need IELTS/TOEFL per the university. Majors available at each university are listed on the CSC website.
summary.source_text: be a master's degree holder under the age of 40 when applying for doctoral programs

summary.detail: Non-degree General scholar (high school graduate under 45) and Senior scholar (master's holder or associate professor or above, under 50) categories also exist.
summary.source_text: be a master's degree holder or an associate professor (or above) under the age of 50

notes: Umbrella scheme: no single programme list exists. Each university's available majors are in the Study in China / CSC programme search (campuschina.org, csc.edu.cn), which returned HTTP 412 to fetch and rendered blank in the browser pane, so no catalogue content could be read. Montreal consulate text: 'Available majors for each university are on the CSC website (campuschina.org)'.

Montreal page: Type A, agency number 1244, deadline February 22, 2026, candidates recommended by the Quebec ministry (MES). US embassy page says 'Grand under this application only covers the AY 2026/2027 funding' and gives a 'Degree seeking program at Bachelor, Master or Doctoral level'; it also states online application opens February 16, 2026 (the earlier pass recorded this as a deadline; the US page's exact meaning of the date was not resolved here).
Official-site wording for the bachelor Chinese-language requirement differs by category: Chinese-taught undergraduate or general scholar HSK Level 3.
Durations are not stated on the embassy pages; none recorded.
